mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, check how I feel, and sit on the edge of the bed before getting up. I leave my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand when I take them off.
mara.intention: Start gently and avoid spending energy before I know what is realistic.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into lounge pants and an evening sweater, and leave my work clothes untouched.
mara.intention: Get comfortable without attempting a normal workday.

mara.activity: Make a mug of tea with lemon and honey, carry it to the kitchen island, and eat yogurt with a banana while sitting quietly.
mara.intention: Have something soothing and easy before deciding whether I need medicine.

mara.activity: Take cold medicine according to the label if needed, send one brief confirmation to the studio that I am still ill and unavailable, then put my phone down.
mara.intention: Close the loop without opening a work conversation.

mara.activity: Return to the main bedroom and rest in bed with the lights low, keeping water within reach. I doze if I can.
mara.intention: Let the illness take the time it needs instead of forcing productivity.

mara.activity: Wake, drink water, and sit quietly in the living room with my paperback book. I stop reading as soon as the words lose their shape.
mara.intention: Change rooms without committing to an activity that requires concentration.

mara.activity: Make a fresh mug of tea and carry it to the island, then rinse the mug and straighten only the immediate sink area.
mara.intention: Do one small useful thing without turning it into housework.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional, listening to nothing and keeping my phone nearby for essential messages only.
mara.intention: Preserve energy through the middle of the day.

mara.activity: Prepare toast and scrambled eggs slowly at the kitchen island, then eat from the plate without setting the dining table.
mara.intention: Get a warm, plain meal without making many decisions.

mara.activity: Carry the plate and skillet to the sink, wash them, and wipe only the part of the island I used.
mara.intention: Leave the kitchen usable while stopping before I become overtired.

mara.activity: Take a long quiet rest in the main bedroom, with the phone on silent and water nearby.
mara.intention: Sleep or lie still through the afternoon dip.

mara.activity: Wake, drink water, and sit on the edge of the bed before moving to the living room. I do not attempt studio work or household planning.
mara.intention: Reassess gently rather than assuming I have recovered.

mara.activity: Read a few pages on the living room sectional, then rest with the book closed when concentration fades.
mara.intention: Have a quiet transition into the evening while Julian follows his own work schedule.

mara.activity: Prepare another simple dinner of toast and scrambled eggs at the island, carrying the plate and mug to my place as I finish each item.
mara.intention: Eat enough without expecting myself to cook a proper dinner.

mara.activity: Eat seated at the island, drinking tea and water, with no attempt to hold a conversation or make decisions.
mara.intention: Keep the evening quiet and manageable.

mara.activity: Rinse the dinner things, wash the skillet, and wipe the island clear enough for tomorrow.
mara.intention: Do the minimum reset and leave deeper cleaning for when I am well.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional with the lights softer, drinking water and answering only essential messages.
mara.intention: Allow the evening to be quiet and let Julian have his own schedule without managing him.

mara.activity: Make one last mug of tea, carry it to the bedroom, and drink it while sitting quietly on the bed.
mara.intention: Settle my throat and make the transition to sleep unhurried.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into sleep pants and a sleep shirt, and put my phone on its charger.
mara.intention: Follow the bedtime routine without adding anything demanding.

mara.activity: Get into bed, place my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, and read only a few pages before turning out the light.
mara.intention: End the day with rest rather than trying to recover lost work time.

mara.activity: Sleep.
mara.intention: Give my body a full night to recover.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes while quietly checking how she is feeling.
julian.intention: Notice whether she needs practical help without waking or pressing her into conversation.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Get ready efficiently while keeping the house quiet.

julian.activity: Make tea with honey and a small yogurt-and-banana bowl, carry them to the kitchen island, and leave a covered portion nearby for Mara if she wants it later.
julian.intention: Offer something mild and easy without making food into a demand.

julian.activity: Drink coffee and eat a little breakfast at the island, then sit with my piano music book for quiet music before work.
julian.intention: Keep to my usual calming routine while remaining available if Mara calls for me.

julian.activity: Pack my backpack with water, phone, reading glasses, tablet, and a paperback book; collect my keys from the piano middle shelf and put on my jacket.
julian.intention: Leave prepared and send Mara one brief practical check-in before heading out.

julian.activity: Travel to the restaurant and handle deliveries, prep, stock checks, and kitchen management.
julian.intention: Keep the kitchen moving and make sure the supplier deliveries are received and organized.

julian.activity: Take a quiet lunch break, drink water, and send Mara a short message asking only whether she needs anything practical brought home.
julian.intention: Stay connected without interrupting her rest or workday.

julian.activity: Return home, set my backpack beside the kitchen island, bring the thermos to the sink, and check quietly on Mara.
julian.intention: Assess how she is doing before the evening service and respond to any immediate need.

julian.activity: Make a small pot of gentle tomato-and-carrot soup, leave a covered bowl on the kitchen island, and eat a little myself while keeping the kitchen calm.
julian.intention: Care for Mara and make sure I have enough fuel for the late service.

julian.activity: Rinse the stockpot and bowl, refill the thermos, change into my chef jacket and apron, collect my backpack and keys, and send Mara one final practical message before leaving.
julian.intention: Set up a simple, reassuring evening for her before returning to work.

julian.activity: Travel to the restaurant, run dinner service, and complete closing duties.
julian.intention: Stay focused through the crowded service and close carefully despite the late finish.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, and check that Mara is settled.
julian.intention: Come down from service and make sure she is safe before taking care of myself.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep clothes without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Use the familiar low-decision routine that helps me recover after service.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of soup or yogurt, drink water, put my phone on its charger, and return my wallet and earplugs to my pockets.
julian.intention: Have something gentle, then avoid extra activity so I can sleep.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara and sleep.
julian.intention: Rest for the next demanding workday while keeping the room quiet and comfortable.
